what_to_detect: A resolution of a triggered zone-change ability with an Until duration (Duration$ UntilHostLeavesPlay) whose specified event happened after it triggered: no zone_change event for the object. (script_param reads only the root segment, which for a trigger is the trigger itself; the Duration$ sits in the executed sub-ability segment (Banisher Priest's SV1). A chain_param reading any segment of the line's chain would detect it.)
near_miss: A resolution of the same kind of ability whose specified event has not happened, holding the zone_change.
record_fields: snapshot entity zone of the source

what_to_detect: An object an until-effect returns to the battlefield enters under its owner's control, even where another player controlled it when it left.
near_miss: An object returned the same way whose owner already controlled it when it left.
record_fields: entity owner (gen-3) and controller in the next record's snapshot
controller in the snapshot before the object left

what_to_detect: A phasing turn-based action in which a permanent phased out by an until-effect does not phase in during its controller's untap step.
near_miss: A permanent phased out on its own (no until-effect) that phases in during the untap step.

what_to_detect: A resolution of a phase-out ability lasting until its source leaves the battlefield, whose source left while it was on the stack: its condition (ConditionPresent$ Card.Self) is not met and no phased-out event is held. (the Phases sub-ability is a later segment of the chain, not the root)
near_miss: A resolution of the same kind with its source still present, holding the phased-out event.

what_to_detect: A resolution of a triggered phase-out ability lasting until its source leaves the battlefield, whose source left after it triggered: its condition (ConditionPresent$ Card.Self) is not met and no phased-out event is held. (the trigger's root segment is the trigger; WontPhaseInNormal$ is in the executed Phases segment)
near_miss: A resolution of the same kind with its source still present, holding the phased-out event.

what_to_detect: A decision candidate for a spell whose cost-paying keyword (convoke, improvise ...) is granted by another permanent's static: the candidate's card lists that keyword line flagged granted, and the candidate is affordable.
near_miss: A candidate for a spell the static does not grant the keyword to, or whose keyword cannot pay, unaffordable.
record_fields: candidate card lines[] with kind keyword and granted (gen-3)
